items.title: Musiala shares health update after second in-game collapse
items.description: Bayern Munich winger Jamal Musiala has revealed he is suffering from “treatable absence seizures” after he collapsed on the pitch for the second time in four days.

items.title: Musiala collapses during match for second time in four-day period
items.description: Bayern Munich midfielder Jamal Musiala says he is being treated for a "neurological dysfunction" after collapsing during a match for the second time in a four-day period.

items.title: Arteta: We want to be the best club in the world
items.description: Mikel Arteta is excited to keep building Arsenal after their Premier League win, vowing to make them "the best club in the world".

Irish striker Parrott on brink of Real Betis move
items.description: Republic of Ireland striker Troy Parrott is on the brink of a move from AZ Alkmaar to Spanish club Real Betis as talks are at an advanced stage.

items.description: Martin O'Neill believes Celtic should "aspire" to win the Champions League ahead of their play-off round qualifier against Austrian champions LASK.

items.title: Aston Villa agree deal for West Ham's Wan-Bissaka
items.description: Aston Villa agree to sign West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka on an initial loan deal with an obligation to buy at the end of the season.

items.title: Fifa sacking 'deeply troubling' - Uefa executive
items.description: Fifa's decision to dismiss senior executive Kevin Lamour following his criticism of president Gianni Infantino sends a "deeply troubling message to all of us seeking change", says UEFA vice-president Laura McAllister.
